rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a demonstration or visual explanation.

example.english: This demo is very clear; I understood how to install the machine as soon as I saw it.
example.traditional: 呢段示範好清楚，我一睇就明白點樣裝部機。

rows.note: Use this specifically for a political protest march or gathering.

example.english: Many people joined the demo this time, demanding that the government withdraw that decision.

rows.note: Use this for software released with limited functions so people can try it before buying the full version.
